notes.content:

Eufloria Classic is the upcoming anniversary edition of Eufloria, and it is now in open beta. If you'd like to join the beta, simply join our Discord server and follow the instructions in the #join-test channel.
CLICK HERE TO JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER
Or use this link if the button doesn't work - https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z
Streaming/Recording
We encourage any beta participants to record, live stream, and share clips/screenshots of the game wherever they like. We're especially interested in people testing the two new modes, and please remember this is a beta and bugs are to be expected.

notes.title: Eufloria Classic Coming Soon on Steam!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to reveal a renewal of the much-loved, Bafta nominated franchise Eufloria! Set to launch imminently on Steam, Eufloria Classic will bring back the original charms of the long-unavailable indie classic, updated for a new age with a plethora of new content and features, including extreme moddability. The release marks the return of the Eufloria genus, with more original titles currently under development. Keep your eyes open, as more will be revealed very soon!

Original Features: 

 25 level Single player campaign
 8 Level “Skirmish Mode”
 Unlockable “Dark Matter” mode
 Hours of wonderful ambient music by “Milieu”
 Procedural levels – great for replayability
 Community levels

New Features:

 New “Survivalist” Game Mode
 New Peaceful “Gardening Mode”
 New Levels
 New original music by “Milieu”
 Speedup Controls
 New modding features
 Many free bonus assets, including art, early game iterations & more 

Wishlist Eufloria classic now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3254570/Eufloria_Classic/ 

We are also delighted to announce that the demo for Omni Systems Ltd new title, Bioframe Outpost, is available now. Head to store page and try it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/463730/Bioframe_Outpost/ 

Bioframe Outpost touches on similar themes as Eufloria, offering musings on evolution, conflict, and nature - this time through the lens of a photography-based Metroidvania. Bioframe even contains Eufloria related Easter eggs! 

Take a look at the newest gameplay trailer here:

notes.title: EUFLORIA X DISCORD
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4465261/c23ed6165c586a05e7e785f8689f2a354e08490d.jpg

Hello Euflorians, it's been a little while since we've had any Eufloria news to share but that all changes TODAY!

We're excited to announce that we now have our very own Discord server where we'll be chatting about the future of our games, hanging out with you wonderful people, and posting a boatload of behind the scenes/in-dev stuff.

So if you want to stay up to date on any Eufloria news (And there will be more Eufloria news) then you should absolutely click below and join your fellow Euflorians in our rapidly growing server!

Omni Systems Discord

notes.title: Release Notes V1.2.0 (Windows/MacOSX)
notes.content:
Right mouse drag (shortcut) - from one asteroid to another will send all of your units from the source to the target asteroid in a single operation.

Updated to use SDL2 - for better fullscreen switching, window handling and joystick support (including XInput).

OS User Names - containing umlauts should now save progress and options correctly.

Added joystick support when activating artifacts.

Higher resolution title logo.

Mac: Retina Support.

Bug fixes.

Note: Any existing joystick mappings will be reset on the first run and will need reconfiguring (if you have any customisations) - this is due to SDL2 mapping controllers differently from the previous version.
